summary: First-finish smoke tests for Kamala Muditam nonprofit site. Backend: all 10 API scenarios verified. Frontend: home, focus areas, focus detail page, multi-step Join Journey (submit success), Contact submit, Admin login+dashboard, Ripples category filter, People page, and Footer navigation all working. Admin dashboard confirmed volunteer submitted via UI (UI Test User) and contact via UI (UI Contact).

POST /api/volunteers with consent=false (all fields) -> 400 'Consent is required to proceed.'
Home page loads with hero + both CTAs; hero-cta-join navigates to /become-part-of-the-journey
Where Our Hearts Lead Us page renders 10 focus cards; focus-list-children-education navigates to detail
Focus area detail has 'Our Heart', 'How We Walk Alongside', 'Join This Journey' sections; focus-join-cta navigates with ?focus=children-education
Join Journey 4-step flow: begin -> Step1 fill -> Step2 focus select -> Step3 contribution -> Step4 story+consent -> submit -> 'Welcome to the Journey' success
Admin login -> dashboard shows stats and UI Test User volunteer + contacts
People page renders content matching all 7 group keywords
action_items: Minor: review request expected data-testid 'input-full-name' etc., but actual code uses underscores like 'input-full_name'. Both work; documentation/test spec mismatch only. Not a bug.
